runs.question: Which four functions make up the NIST AI RMF Core, and which one is described as cross-cutting?

answer.text:
The NIST AI RMF Core has four top-level functions: GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE. These functions are broken down further into categories and subcategories.

GOVERN is the cross-cutting function. In NIST AI 100-1, it is designed to be a cross-cutting function to inform and be infused throughout the other three functions. It also has a broader reach than the others: while GOVERN applies to all stages of organizations' AI risk management processes and procedures, the MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE functions can be applied in AI system-specific contexts and at specific stages of the AI lifecycle.
